description: Northstar provider integrations — Bright Data, RapidAPI, DataForSEO, Chocodata, Unwrangle, Scavio.
rules: Bright Data Web Unlocker (zone northstaros): 1 credit/request, free tier 5k/mo shared pool, hard stop at 0 when unfunded.
Chocodata: /amazon/search = 5 credits/call, free 1k credits on signup. SCANNER_SEARCH_SOURCE=CHOCODATA supported.
Unwrangle: 1 credit/ASIN (US), 10 credits/search page (up to 96 products). COSTCO_CATALOG_SOURCE=UNWRANGLE supported.
DataForSEO: Merchant Standard queue only (products/asin/sellers). Labs Live gated (DATAFORSEO_LABS_AUTO_SUBMIT). Adapter OFFLINE BY DEFAULT.
RapidAPI (Easyparser): ~5 credits/ASIN for OFFER operation. Per-ASIN enrichment only for scoreable rows (Costco cost exists + exact fingerprint).
Scavio: transport_error classification, bare print-and-swallow removed. 1 credit/ASIN estimate.
All live enrichment credit-gated: only runs where row can score (Costco cost + exact/invoice-confirmed fingerprint).
Enrichment caches: enriched-offer-cache.json (24h TTL), seller-offer-cache.json (24h TTL). Offline placeholders never cached.
